title: At Risk trend line has twelve monthly points and the last equals the count
pre_body:
Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. Location: you are in a location (workplace) with several months of invoice history (many customers, invoices going back more than a year). At Risk needs old invoices, which cannot be back-dated by hand.
  3. Data (Customer V): with the At Risk Customers window on 120 Days, an at-risk customer whose newest invoice is from 2 to 6 months ago and who also has an older invoice. You have written down both invoice dates.
  4. User: your role can reverse an invoice (Admin can).
